title: TxInsight
tagline: A dashboard for wallet analysis that tracks transaction history with detailed
description: TxInsight is a decentralized finance (DeFi) wallet analysis dashboard that provides users with real-time insights into their cryptocurrency portfolios and transaction history across EVM-compatible blockchains. TxInsight aggregates portfolio balances, transaction details, and token prices, offering a user-friendly interface for managing and analyzing DeFi activities.
how_its_made:
This project utilizes React.js and Tailwind CSS. The backend was built using Node.js and Express.js.       1inch API was used to fetch portfolio balances, transaction details, and token prices.

- **Frontend**: React.js, Chart.js (for visualizations), Tailwindcss (for styling)
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express.js
- **APIs**: 1inch Balance API, History API, Spot Price API
